BLAKE.keywords.Charge.title: Charge
BLAKE.keywords.Charge.description: Stored damage on your fist meter. Starts at base each combat. [gold]Rev[/gold] doubles it. [gold]Unleash[/gold] spends it for damage, then resets to base. Taking unblocked attack damage [gold]halves[/gold] Charge (never below base).
BLAKE.keywords.Rev.title: Rev
BLAKE.keywords.Rev.description: Double your [gold]Charge[/gold]. All charging is multiplicative.
BLAKE.keywords.Unleash.title: Unleash
BLAKE.keywords.Unleash.description: Deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold], then reset [gold]Charge[/gold] to base.
BLAKE.keywords.Sweetspot.title: Sweetspot
BLAKE.keywords.Sweetspot.description: A bonus if the stated condition is true — usually if the enemy intends to Attack.
BLAKE.keywords.Combo.title: Combo
BLAKE.keywords.Combo.description: Bonus if this is at least the Nth card you've played this turn.
BLAKE.keywords.Follow-Through.title: Follow-Through
BLAKE.keywords.Follow-Through.descriptio: Excess damage from this attack hits another enemy.
